critique: The monumental upper-left cluster of ochre, teal, clay, and stone facets anchors a confident high-key composition, while the widely separated right-hand shard and low planes make the linen-colored intervals carry real tension. The tiny cartoon guinea pig and datestamp introduce stylistically unrelated extra marks, weakening both the Cubist vocabulary and the brief’s strict three-or-four-mark economy; remove them and let the four geometric groups stand alone.
